tools.name: get_bet_stop_status
tools.description: Whether each market is in a bet stop (stop: true when something just happened that can be front-run, e.g. a score) and whether its price is widened. Needs an API key with plan risk.

tools.name: get_consensus
tools.description: The consensus: a market-implied probability per outcome (home, away, draw) for games starting within 24 hours and those being played, at most 1 s old. recent false means no current consensus. Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_live
tools.description: Games being played now (and final within 2 hours): score, period, clock. Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_pass_options
tools.description: The plans for sale, their prices (USD), trials and checkout links, where a key is bought, and the x402 passes (a plan for a period, paid in USDC). Works without an API key.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: A free sample without an API key: one league's consensus (kind odds, 60 to 120 s old, without stop and widened) or today's fixtures (kind fixtures), 10 fixtures at most. Limited to 10 calls a minute.

tools.name: list_fixtures
tools.description: A league's schedule on a date: fixture ids, start times (UTC), teams, status (Scheduled, In Progress, Final, Postponed, ...), postponement links. Needs an API key.

tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: The leagues served, with their ids, names and sports. Needs an API key.
